sources.note: Splits a video model's latent computation into perception latents that always ground the question in visual evidence and reasoning latents allocated only when the question needs inference, and shows that reasoning latents without rationale supervision are worse than no reasoning latents at all.
sources.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering

sources.note: An open library giving vision-language models the mechanistic-interpretability tooling that text-only models already have: activation patching, attention analysis and meta-functions behind one interface.
sources.title: Spectra: A Mechanistic Interpretability Library for Vision-Language Models

sources.note: An inference-time safeguard that reads a reasoning model's attention to find key points in its reasoning path and injects safety reflections there, then scales sampling to pick a safe path.
sources.title: ReasoningGuard: Safeguarding Large Reasoning Models with Inference-time Safety Aha Moments

sources.note: Detects reasoning hallucinations by measuring how strongly cross-step attention routing aligns with hidden-state semantic proximity, finding that higher alignment means higher hallucination risk.
sources.title: RFS-Guard: Detecting Reasoning Hallucinations via Cross-Phase Routing Focus in Large Reasoning Models

result.definition: Where a model attends at a given position, read across 4 sources as a routing signal and, consistently, as one that says where the model looked rather than what it found. Its productive uses here are as an index into something else: finding the key points in a reasoning path at which to inject a safety reflection, or measuring how routing focus shifts across reasoning phases to detect hallucination. Its limitation is the archive's recurring one -- in vision-language hallucination, attention alone does not separate real from hallucinated objects and only what the attended region decodes to does. One library in the set exists to make patterns inspectable for vision-language models with the tooling text-only models already have.
